# Each line MUST NOT match any rule in git.yaml.
# Lines starting with # or blank are skipped.

# Normal commits
git commit -m "feat: add foo"
git commit --message "fix bug"
git commit -am "wip"

# Normal pushes
git push origin feat/x
git push -u origin feat/x
git push origin :stale-branch

# --force-with-lease to non-protected branch is allowed (only protected rule fires for protected names)
git push --force-with-lease origin feat/my-branch
git push --force-with-lease origin user/jadb/wip

# Reset variants that are not destructive
git reset HEAD
git reset --soft HEAD~1
git reset --mixed HEAD~1

# Clean variants without force or directory recursion
git clean -n
git clean --dry-run
git clean -i

# Add explicit paths
git add file.go
git add internal/foo.go internal/bar.go
git add -p

# Config that is not the disable knobs
git config user.email "me@example.com"
git config core.editor vim
git config --get remote.origin.url

# Other safe operations
git status
git log --oneline
git diff
git stash push -u -m "wip"
git checkout feat/x
git branch -d merged-branch
git rebase main
git pull --ff-only

# Strings that contain --no-verify but not in commit context
echo "the --no-verify flag is dangerous"
grep -r 'no-verify' .

# Strings that mention force in non-push context
echo "force the issue"
git rebase main --force-rebase

# branches that look protected but are not
git push --force-with-lease origin feat/release-notes
